mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NUTRITION_ANALYSIS (video_id, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{videoId}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, video_id AS videoId, status, total_calories AS totalCalories, total_carbs AS totalCarbs, total_protein AS totalProtein, total_fat AS totalFat, foods_json AS foodsJson, retry_count AS retryCount, error_message AS errorMessage, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM NUTRITION_ANALYSIS WHERE video_id = #{videoId}
mapper.update: UPDATE NUTRITION_ANALYSIS SET status = #{status}, total_calories = #{totalCalories}, total_carbs = #{totalCarbs}, total_protein = #{totalProtein}, total_fat = #{totalFat}, foods_json = #{foodsJson}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RECOGNIZED_FOOD_ITEM (nutrition_analysis_id, food_name, calories, carbs, protein, fat, quantity) VALUES (#{nutritionAnalysisId}, #{foodName}, #{calories}, #{carbs}, #{protein}, #{fat}, IFNULL(#{quantity}, 1.0))
mapper.select: SELECT id, nutrition_analysis_id AS nutritionAnalysisId, food_name AS foodName, calories, carbs, protein, fat, quantity FROM RECOGNIZED_FOOD_ITEM WHERE nutrition_analysis_id = #{nutritionAnalysisId} ORDER BY id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(na.total_calories), 0) AS totalCalories, COALESCE(SUM(na.total_carbs), 0) AS totalCarbs, COALESCE(SUM(na.total_protein), 0) AS totalProtein, COALESCE(SUM(na.total_fat), 0) AS totalFat FROM NUTRITION_ANALYSIS na JOIN VIDEOS v ON v.id = na.video_id WHERE v.meal_date = #{date} AND v.user_id = #{userId} AND na.status = 'DONE'

SELECT na.id, na.video_id AS videoId, na.status, na.total_calories AS totalCalories, na.total_carbs AS totalCarbs, na.total_protein AS totalProtein, na.total_fat AS totalFat, na.foods_json AS foodsJson, na.retry_count AS retryCount, na.error_message AS errorMessage, na.created_at AS createdAt, na.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM NUTRITION_ANALYSIS na JOIN VIDEOS v ON v.id = na.video_id WHERE v.meal_date = #{date} AND v.user_id = #{userId} AND na.status = 'DONE'
